'''Edolo''' (Etoro) is a [[Papuan language]] of [[Papua New Guinea]], spoken by the [[Etoro people]]. As of 2015, there were 300 monolingual speakers.<ref name=eth26/> It is part of the [[Bosavi languages|Bosavi]] branch of the [[Trans–New Guinea languages|Trans–New Guinea language family]].<ref>Shaw, R.D.
